summary: theforeman.foreman activation_key deprecates content_view and lifecycle_environment in favor of content_view_environments.
questions: How do I set the content view on a Foreman activation key now?

answer_card.title: activation_key content_view deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `theforeman.foreman.activation_key`, `content_view` and `lifecycle_environment` are deprecated. Use **`content_view_environments`** instead.
